name: 左右留邊的輪播卡片＋中央直式主體圖，下方窄條放按鈕
desc: 左右留邊、上緣貼齊的卡片內是橫向滑動的滿版圖片輪播，中央疊一張直式主體圖；卡片下方的窄條放一顆置中按鈕，左右留邊處各有一行直向小字。
prompt: 主視覺是卡片，左右兩側留邊，上緣貼齊主視覺頂端，下方緊接一條窄條；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都為直角。卡片約佔畫面寬的九成，佔主視覺的大部分高度。卡片內是多張滿版背景圖片的輪播，每張停留數秒後以橫向滑動切換到下一張，播完最後一張後回到第一張繼續。卡片正中央疊一張直式的主體圖，在背景圖片前面，高度約佔卡片的三分之二、下緣接近卡片底邊；主體圖跟著每張投影片一起換。卡片內不放大標題。
mobile: 高度改為底邊約在畫面九成高的位置，下方露出下一個區塊的開頭；卡片下方的窄條保留。卡片改為左側與上緣貼齊、右側留一條較寬的邊，四個角仍為直角；背景圖片改為直式裁切。主體圖從中央移到卡片右下方，仍在背景圖片前面。卡片右側的留邊處可放一段直排的次要文字，沒有內容時省略。輪播保留，同樣橫向滑動切換。

en.name: Side-margin slideshow card with a centered portrait image and a button strip below
en.desc: A card with margins on the left and right and flush with the top holds a horizontally sliding full-bleed image slideshow, with a portrait image layered in the center; a strip below the card holds a centered button, and each side margin carries a small line of text rotated to read vertically.
en.prompt: The hero is a card with margins on the left and right, flush with the top of the hero, with a narrow strip directly below it; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right) are square. The card takes about ninety percent of the viewport width and most of the hero's height. Inside the card is a slideshow of multiple full-bleed background images; each one stays for a few seconds, then slides horizontally to the next, and after the last one it returns to the first and continues. A portrait image is layered at the exact center of the card, in front of the background image, about two thirds of the card's height, with its bottom edge close to the bottom of the card; it changes together with each slide. There is no headline inside the card.
en.mobile: The height changes so that the bottom edge sits at about ninety percent of the viewport height, revealing the start of the next section below; the strip below the card is kept. The card becomes flush with the left edge and the top, with a wider margin on the right, and all four corners stay square; the background images are cropped to portrait. The portrait image moves from the center to the bottom-right of the card, still in front of the background image. Optionally place a block of secondary text set vertically in the card's right margin; omit it when there is no content. The slideshow is kept, still sliding horizontally.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺左側留邊處的中段放一行旋轉成直向的小標籤（次要文字），內容跟著每張投影片一起換。
accessories.mobile: 左側旋轉成直向的小標籤在手機版隱藏。

en.prompt: Place a small label of secondary text rotated to read vertically at the middle of the hero's left margin; its content changes with each slide.
en.mobile: The vertically rotated small label on the left is hidden on mobile.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺右側留邊處的中段放一個小標籤（旋轉成直向）和它下方的一個箭頭圖示按鈕，點擊後輪播切換到下一張。
accessories.mobile: 右側切換到下一張的箭頭圖示按鈕與小標籤在手機版隱藏。

en.prompt: Place a small label (rotated to read vertically) with an arrow icon button below it at the middle of the hero's right margin; clicking it moves the slideshow to the next slide.
en.mobile: The next-slide arrow icon button and its label on the right are hidden on mobile.

accessories.prompt: 在卡片下方的整列窄條放一個主要按鈕，水平置中，窄條緊接在卡片底邊下方。

en.prompt: Place a primary button, horizontally centered, in a full-width strip directly below the card; the strip sits right under the card's bottom edge.
